commercialPurpose: Open a startup or lead-generation page with immediate value proposition, two action paths, and dark high-contrast credibility mood.
purposeLayer: Hero frames the offer as simple and ready-to-start, pushing trial/demo action before detailed explanation.
anatomyLayer: Dark photographic or product-context background, centered eyebrow, bold headline, two CTAs, and small scroll cue.
hierarchyLayer: Headline first, CTA pair second, background product atmosphere third, scroll cue last.
gridRhythmLayer: Single centered text stack floats over a full-width dark media stage with generous vertical height.
densityLimitLayer: Use 1 primary message, 1 eyebrow, 2 CTAs maximum, 1 controlled media/background system, and optional scroll cue.
originalityLayer: Learn centered dual-action startup masthead logic; transform color, media source, CTA wording, and proof cue for new products.
usageRuleLayer: Use for lead-gen, startup, SaaS, app, and productized service landing pages where action clarity matters before feature density.
layoutGesture: dark centered offer masthead with dual CTA path
sectionSilhouette: full-width dark hero slab with centered text stack
compositionTension: bright CTA pair held against a quiet dark product-photo background
focalPath: eyebrow to headline to dual CTAs to scroll cue
negativeSpaceShape: large dark field around a compact centered message island
depthLayering: background image plane under translucent dark overlay and foreground controls
moduleScaleVariation: oversized hero field with small CTA controls
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact dark office/product background, copy line, coral CTA pair, or circular scroll icon.
